title: Grateful Dead Live at Harpur College on 1970-05-02
source: reel> cass > cass; Nak Dr-1 > Lynx Studio Interface at 32 bit float / 96 kHz Weiss Saracon for BRC to 24 bit / 96 kHz by Jamie Waddell; Resampled from 96 to 44.1 khz in r8brain Pro > dithered in Izotope Ozone 3 (MBIT+, high noise shaping, 16 bit depth, normal dither, DC offset filter on) > exported to 16 bit in Audacity 2.0.0 > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Great‑sounding recording that captures a blistering Cosmic Charlie and an epic Other One, with most of the show flowing as one seamless jam.
ai_review.review: Listeners rave about the ferocious electric set—especially a smoking Cosmic Charlie and a monumental The Other One—that flow straight from the acoustic portion without any breaks.  The audio is described as clear and pleasant, though the archive only contains part of the full concert, leaving some fans wishing for the missing DP‑8 material.

ai_rating.rationale: Over a dozen enthusiastic 5‑star reviews praise both performance (standout jams) and sound quality; only minor criticism concerns the incomplete nature of the release.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers call it a "great sounding recording" with clear acoustic detail and solid electric mix. No major audio defects are mentioned, but several notes point out that the full show is not present.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set leads straight into a high‑energy electric half; tracks 13‑16 are noted as one uninterrupted performance, giving the concert a seamless, jam‑centric flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar work is highlighted—especially melodic passages at the start of The Other One and his blazing solo later in the jam.
